candidate.title: TruSeq Custom Amplicon
candidate.scope: The single DNA-targeted library-preparation outline titled TruSeq Custom Amplicon. It runs from double-stranded DNA containing a region of interest through custom-probe addition, extension and ligation, sequencing-primer addition and PCR to a product ready for cluster generation. No version, alternative workflow, sequencing reaction or primary-paper association is specified.

features: Two parallel DNA lines are labelled Double-stranded DNA; the next view highlights an internal Region of interest in dark blue.
The small interruption marks in the upper DNA cartoon do not label a fragmentation operation.

evidence.locator: Upper DNA cartoons: Double-stranded DNA and Region of interest

evidence.locator: Custom Probe 1 / Custom Probe 2 labels and colored segments

states.label: DNA target with the custom probes positioned at its flanks
features: A single displayed template line carries the dark-blue target region, with green and magenta custom probes at its two boundaries.
Exposure of the template from the double-stranded input is implicit; no separate strand-separation operation is labelled.

evidence.locator: Add custom probes row below the first downward arrow

states.label: Continuous target-spanning extension/ligation product on the DNA template
features: The newly continuous upper line comprises a green left segment, dark-blue target-spanning segment and magenta right segment over the longer template line.

states.label: Sequencing primers with P7/Index 1 and Index 2/P5 tails

features: The target-spanning blue line is flanked by paired green and magenta segments and the labelled primer tails.
This is the pre-PCR primer-addition boundary; complete tail incorporation is represented in the final PCR product.

evidence.locator: Add sequencing primers row above the PCR arrow

states.label: Indexed target amplicon library: product ready for cluster generation
features: The final line retains the central dark-blue target segment with colored flanks.
The final cartoon labels P5 and Index 2 at the left and Index 1 and P7 at the right.
No strand polarity or chemical terminal groups are labelled; the single-line cartoon alone does not establish final library strandedness.

operations.label: Add custom probes
operations.description: Add the two custom probes to the DNA target; the output drawing positions Custom Probe 1 and Custom Probe 2 at opposite boundaries of the region of interest.
operations.information_effect: The probe pair defines the depicted target interval to be represented by the subsequent extension/ligation product.

evidence.locator: Region of interest, downward arrow and Add custom probes row
Custom probes at the two boundaries of the blue region
evidence.rationale: The two probe segments flank the highlighted DNA interval, and the next product spans between them; this supports target definition at schematic scope without establishing perfect specificity.

operations.label: Extension and ligation
operations.description: Convert the separated flank-probe arrangement into a continuous target-spanning product, drawn as green, dark-blue and magenta segments on the longer DNA template.
operations.mechanism: Extension across the target interval and ligation yield the continuous product; individual enzymes and reaction conditions are not identified.
operations.information_effect: The physical carrier of the selected DNA interval becomes the continuous probe-derived, target-spanning product that enters the primer-addition stage.

evidence.locator: Arrow from Add custom probes to Extension and ligation, with continuous upper product
Green-to-blue-to-magenta continuous product over the template
evidence.rationale: The named extension/ligation step replaces separated probe segments with a continuous line spanning the highlighted target, supporting a template-directed target representation without requiring a named enzyme.

operations.label: Add sequencing primers
operations.description: Add the depicted tailed primers to the extension/ligation product. The resulting assembly has primers at the colored ends and outer tails labelled P7/Index 1 and Index 2/P5.
operations.information_effect: Brings the index-labelled and P5/P7-labelled primer tails into the assembly used for PCR; the drawing does not depict adapter ligation as a separate operation.

evidence.locator: Downward arrow from Extension and ligation to Add sequencing primers and labelled tails

operations.label: PCR
operations.description: Amplify the primed target-spanning product to yield the final indexed amplicon carrying P5 and P7 ends, labelled ready for cluster generation.
operations.mechanism: PCR, as labelled; no cycling settings or enzyme identity are specified.
operations.information_effect: The final DNA amplicon co-carries the represented target interval and Index 1/Index 2. Subsequent sequencing could read the selected DNA interval; no read generation or index-to-sample assignment is shown, and this outline does not establish original-molecule counts or perfect target specificity.

evidence.rationale: The target color persists from the labelled region of interest into the indexed final product, supporting DNA-target representation in the sequencing library. The figure stops before clusters or sequence reads.
